build_GlobalNoUTurnSampler: build a GlobalNoUTurnSampler with custom max_tree_depth and target_accept_prob for joint HMC sampling
build_SingleSiteNoUTurnSampler: build a SingleSiteNoUTurnSampler to sample each random variable in the World one at a time
run_GlobalNoUTurnSampler_get_proposers: run get_proposers on a GlobalNoUTurnSampler to create a single NUTSProposer for all target random variables
run_SingleSiteNoUTurnSampler_get_propose: run get_proposers on a SingleSiteNoUTurnSampler to create per-variable NUTSProposers for each target RV
review_NUTS_sampler_adaptation: review the NUTS sampler classes to understand adaptive step size and mass matrix configuration options
